thread:
maria_partnerships: Heads-up — AWS Marketplace + Terraform enablement for Redwood Private. Partner asked for a set of reference architectures, reusable Terraform modules, and a 1-pager enablement doc. Target: ship initial artifacts in 2 weeks. Who can own the module + examples?

alex_infra: I can own the Terraform modules and the reference arch diagram.

sara_devex: I’ll take the partner-facing README, usage examples, and a quick video walkthrough.

chris_eng: Will need to call out runtime constraints. Quick notes: modules should support both VPC and non-VPC installs, optional KMS integration, and a flag for on-prem vs cloud-managed control plane. Also include example for dedicated pool sizing.

maria_partnerships: perfect. Can you sketch a minimal example we can show partners? Put the IAM requirements and outputs clearly.

chris_eng: putting a minimal usage snippet here:```hcl
module "redwood_private" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/modules/aws//redwood_private"

  region          = "us-west-2"
  vpc_id          = var.vpc_id # optional
  control_plane   = "managed" # or "self_managed"
  key_manager     = var.kms_key_arn # optional for KMS encrypted volumes
  instance_type   = "g5.12xlarge"
  min_pool_size   = 1
  max_pool_size   = 4
}
```

chris_eng: And IAM perms summary (short):
- ec2:Describe*, RunInstances, TerminateInstances
- iam:PassRole for instance profiles
- kms:Encrypt,Decrypt if KMS enabled
- s3:GetObject for model artifacts

alex_infra: We should also add a second example using EKS + nodegroups for customers who want containerized runtime.

sara_devex: For the README, I’ll include a short troubleshooting matrix and a short command to validate a deployment:```bash
aws ssm send-command --document-name "RedwoodValidate" --targets \"Key=tag:Redwood,Values=redwood-deploy\"
```

maria_partnerships: Legal/Compliance will need a DP addendum note. @neil_legal can you confirm the required language for Marketplace listing?

neil_legal: Short version: Marketplace listing must call out data residency options and KMS usage. For partners we need a DPA + customer-managed KMS supported. Also we can't promise specific uptime in the listing — stick to recommended architectures and link to our SLA page.

maria_partnerships: thanks. Also planning a co-write with AWS partner team on the announcement. @alex_infra can you produce an arch diagram (svg + PNG) and a 1-page bulleted partner enablement checklist by EOD Thursday?

alex_infra: On it. I’ll start the diagram and a checklist: items will include terraform vars, required roles, test deploy steps, and automated smoke tests.

chris_eng: FYI for the modules: add outputs for kubeconfig, instance_role_arn, and a cloudwatch_log_group name so partners can wire observability quickly.

sara_devex: I’ll draft the partner-facing quickstart with copy like: "Deploy Redwood Private on AWS Marketplace in <30 minutes using our Terraform module" — include link to video and link to troubleshooting matrix.

deploy-bot: Created ticket PARTNERS-7321: "AWS Marketplace Terraform modules — initial deliverables" assigned to alex_infra, chris_eng, sara_devex. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PARTNERS-7321

maria_partnerships: great — let’s do a sync on Friday for final review w/ AWS partner manager. If modules are ready earlier we can ask for an early technical review. :thumbsup:

chris_eng: One more ops note — include a small smoke test that runs a 512-token generation against a pinned model and reports p95 latency. That will help Marketplace reviewers validate throughput.

alex_infra: adding smoke test to module outputs and a simple GH Actions workflow to run post-apply.

sara_devex: I’ll prepare the partner slide deck outline (2 slides): 1) architecture + quickstart 2) support and compliance bullets.

maria_partnerships: Awesome. Thanks team — logging progress in the ticket. We’ll loop AWS partner PM once we have the diagram + modules. :rocket:
